title: Incorrect Author export to Hayagriva
body:
### JabRef version

6.0-beta.1

### Operating system

GNU / Linux

### Details on version and operating system

Arch Linux 7.2.6

### Checked with the [latest development build](https://builds.jabref.org/main/) (copy version output from About dialog)

- [x] I made a backup of my libraries before testing the latest development version.
- [x] I have tested the latest development version and the problem persists

### Steps to reproduce the behaviour

1. Create a minimal .bib with the following content:
```bibtex
@Misc{examplekey,
  author = {{Some company}},
  month  = may,
  title  = {{Lorem Ipsum}},
  year   = {2077},
}
```
2. Export the entry to Hayagriva. The result is:
```yaml
examplekey:
  type: Misc
  title: "{Lorem Ipsum}"
  author:
    - {Some company}
  date: 2077-05
```
but should be:
```yaml
examplekey:
  type: Misc
  title: "{Lorem Ipsum}"
  author:
    - Some company
  date: 2077-05
```
as the curly braces around the author in YAML are a map with the "Some company" key and no value.
3. Compile a typst document using the .yaml. 


### Appendix

_No response_
